objective: Isolate the n19 factor-base selection effect at fixed dimension, Frobenius schedule, solver, curve and exact membership model.
fixed_conditions: Both arms use k=6, schedule [0,1,2], the same targets per stream, exact lift clauses, chained S3, the same Gaussian WDSat binary, and identical stopping/rank rules.
intended_difference: Only the direction basis differs: fixed first six trace-zero monomials versus the preselected sparse density winner. Actual factor columns and exact-clause count are consequences of that basis choice and are the measured mechanism.
eigenvalue: Compute lambda from T^2-tT+2 modulo r and select the root by one public point equality; do not build a subgroup logarithm table.
reachability: Use actual curve point additions for validation only. Charge validation setup separately from solver/pipeline measurements.
success: Both arms extract on all streams. A sparse advantage on all streams supports the factor-base yield claim without dimension or schedule confounding.
scope: n19 implementation ablation; no asymptotic or cryptographic-scale claim.
